description: Source file implementing the FrontPanel plugin for controlling front panel indicators, LEDs, brightness, and blinking patterns in a device management system.

classes.name: FrontPanelImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing the front panel control functionalities, including brightness, LEDs, and event handling.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the service, sets up power management and front panel.

methods.name: InitializePowerManager
methods.description: Sets up the power management interface and registers event handlers.

methods.name: onPowerModeChanged
methods.description: Handles power mode change events to update front panel power status.

methods.name: registerEventHandlers
methods.description: Registers event handlers for power management notifications.

methods.name: SetBrightness
methods.description: Sets the brightness of a specified front panel indicator or LED.

methods.name: GetBrightness
methods.description: Retrieves the current brightness of a specified indicator or LED.

methods.name: PowerLedOn
methods.description: Turns on a specified power LED.

methods.name: PowerLedOff
methods.description: Turns off a specified power LED.

methods.name: getFrontPanelLights
methods.description: Returns a list of controllable front panel lights.

methods.name: getFrontPanelLightsInfo
methods.description: Provides detailed info about each front panel light.

methods.name: GetFrontPanelLights
methods.description: Returns an iterator over supported front panel lights.

methods.name: SetLED
methods.description: Sets properties of a specific LED, including brightness and color.

methods.name: setBlink
methods.description: Starts a blinking pattern on an LED based on provided pattern info.

methods.name: SetBlink
methods.description: Parses a JSON string to set blinking pattern on an LED.
